Dana, I haven't drafted the mail yet. Here's why and what happens next.

The $2,356 per-seat rate is a finance figure. Under our rules it can only go to Anselm, June, or the account owner. Hollis isn't one of those, and I couldn't confirm from the share that you own the Quarrendon account, so I can't put the rate in a mail addressed to him on your word alone.

I've asked June Osei-Lark for approval in a DM, with the details of the mail and the pending ID. I'll draft the mail for you as soon as she approves, and you'll review and send it yourself. If she declines, I'll tell you. You could also ask Anselm or June to approve it directly.
